page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It utilizes the x86_64 architecture and includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 for vector neural network instructions and hardware-accelerated cryptography via AES and SHA-NI. No local storage is bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage for persistent data.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.g7.8xlarge in the average tier for most compute and memory operations, with notable strengths in specific memory-bound tasks. The Passmark memory score is rated as strong, supported by a read-only small block memory bandwidth of 1699.39 GB/sec and a large block write bandwidth of 69.91 GB/sec. In compute benchmarks, the instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 13329.0 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU performance of 31013.7. For specialized workloads, the instance demonstrates strong performance in text generation using small language models with 135M parameters at 304.16 tokens per second, while maintaining average performance for medium-sized 7B parameter models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise applications that do not require specialized GPU acceleration or high-speed local NVMe drives. The baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps supports reliable data transfer for distributed environments. This instance is well-suited for workloads such as static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and moderate-scale language model inference.
